typography_styles.label: Геометрический гротеск
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: modern geometric grotesque sans-serif, similar to Inter, Manrope, or Onest. Clean, neutral, highly legible, precise, suitable for premium minimal educational infographics, bento-grid layouts, structured posters, and interface-like compositions.

typography_styles.label: Интерфейсный гротеск
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: neutral UI sans-serif. Clean, functional, calm, highly readable, similar to modern system interface typography. Prioritize clarity, order, and comfortable reading over expressive character.

typography_styles.label: Гуманистический гротеск
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: soft humanist sans-serif. Friendly, warm, readable, with gentle proportions and a less mechanical feeling. Suitable for educational, psychological, humanitarian, family-oriented, and approachable visual content.

typography_styles.label: Строгий неогротеск
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: strict neo-grotesque sans-serif. Rational, restrained, corporate, structured, and objective. Suitable for business, economics, law, management, analytics, and serious institutional topics.

typography_styles.label: Редакционная антиква
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: elegant editorial serif. Refined, intellectual, magazine-like, literary, and culturally rich. Suitable for history, literature, art, philosophy, essays, humanities, and premium editorial layouts.

typography_styles.label: Мягкая антиква
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: modern soft serif. Elegant but accessible, calm, refined, and slightly literary. Suitable for aesthetic educational posters, culture, philosophy, art, psychology, and reflective themes.

typography_styles.label: Акцидентный заголовочный
typography_styles.prompt: Typography: expressive display font for the main title only, paired with a clean sans-serif for all body text. Create strong contrast between the headline and informational text, but keep the overall layout readable, disciplined, and not decorative.

typography_styles.label: Техно / моноширинный
typography_styles.prompt: Font style: modern monospaced or tech-inspired sans-serif. Precise, digital, structured, analytical, and readable. Suitable for topics about code, artificial intelligence, data, cybersecurity, systems, technology, and engineering.

typography_styles.label: Максимальная читаемость
typography_styles.prompt: Typography: simple clean sans-serif with maximum readability. No decorative fonts, no complex lettering, no experimental typography. Prioritize correct, clear, and stable rendering of Russian text above stylistic expression.

font_specificity_modes.label: Только характер
font_specificity_modes.prompt: Do not require a specific font family. Use the selected typographic character and choose a visually appropriate readable font in that style.

font_specificity_modes.label: Предпочтительный шрифт
font_specificity_modes.prompt: Prefer the specified font family. If it is unavailable, use a visually similar fallback font with the same typographic character.

font_specificity_modes.label: Строго заданный шрифт
font_specificity_modes.prompt: Use the specified font family for all text. Do not substitute it unless rendering the text becomes impossible.
